decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The permission hereby granted shall be for a limited period of one year only expiring 28th February 2007 when the use shall cease unless otherwise agreed by the Local Planning Authority following the submission of an application to extend or make permanent the period of consent.

Condition : 2 - The application Unit No.G01D, of the Barley Mow Centre, Barley Mow Passage, shall be used as a non-residential education and training centre for the education and training of adults and for no other purpose within Class D1 Non-Residential Institutions of the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987, including any purpose for the education and training of children, or as an office in accordance with Class B1(Business) (a) of the said Order, and for no other B1 purpose.
Condition : 3 - No music shall be played on the premises or other activities be conducted which result in sound audible outside the premises.
Condition : 4 - The use hereby permitted for D1 non-residential education and training purposes shall only operate between the hours of 7am and 8pm on any day.
description: Change of use from office (B1a) to education and training centre (D1)
